tool.name: xeniumranger_import_segmentation
tool.description: The xeniumranger import-segmentation module allows you to specify 2D nuclei and/or cell segmentation results for assigning transcripts to cells and recalculate all Xenium Onboard Analysis (XOA) outputs that depend on segmentation. param.name: threads
param.label: Number of Threads

tool.help:
**xeniumranger_import_segmentation**
The xeniumranger import-segmentation module allows you to specify 2D nuclei and/or cell segmentation results for assigning transcripts to cells and recalculate all Xenium Onboard Analysis (XOA) outputs that depend on segmentation. Segmentation results can be generated by community-developed tools or prior Xenium segmentation result.
**nf-core Module Information:**
- Module: xeniumranger/import-segmentation - Container: nf-core/xeniumranger:3.0.1
**Usage:** This tool provides the functionality from the nf-core module within Galaxy workflows.
